name: visual-asset-maker
about: The one tool profile Codex runs under on the home computers, attended or overnight. Codex is a visual asset maker and a runner of scripts only (Ruling, Krish, 2026-10-28: "Visual asset maker"): it builds library devices from cards and makes visual plates for named slots. It has no publish, share, deploy, TikTok, Buffer or workflow tool and no escalation path. A card that needs a tool outside allowed_tools is held, never sent (failure production-asked-to-publish: "Codex prepares the board and never publishes directly"). Codex runs no hooks, so this profile, its audit (scripts/overnight/codex_profile.py audit) and the Saturday preflight's codex_profile check are what stop it. Changing this file needs Krish's words in the commit body.
